_crackheadniko: By the time Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik reached R-C9, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. A letter from home found Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik before the night shift. Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik folded it small and kept it close.

Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik snores. Edmund Supergreen does not. Edmund now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik answered to number 618. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained.

Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik had just lit a cigarette at R-C9 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Henrik Sergiootd of the Hegemony (@sergiootd).
Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
abdullahh69420: They issued Ulrich "Spark" Abdullahh a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a key to a house that is no longer there in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
aidanthompson0319: Benedikt Aidanthompso came up the line with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Benedikt Aidanthompso hates silence more than shelling. Today, under fire at Lantern Hill, that habit was the only steady thing in R-S6. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Aidanthompso. Benedikt Aidanthompso read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Benedikt Aidanthompso brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Aidanthompso. Benedikt Aidanthompso read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Benedikt Aidanthompso stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Aidanthompso. Benedikt Aidanthompso read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Benedikt Aidanthompso reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Benedikt Aidanthompso reached up to fix a sandbag at R-S6 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps). Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Aidanthompso. Benedikt Aidanthompso read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Benedikt Aidanthompso got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 475. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Benedikt Aidanthompso kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Benedikt Aidanthompso walked back up the communication trench to R-S6, slower than before, but on his own feet.

A clear shot from R-S6. Benedikt Aidanthompso badly wounded Arno "Shadow" Meloche and slid back down below the parapet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Aidanthompso. Benedikt Aidanthompso read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Benedikt Aidanthompso fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-S6. Casimir "Saint" Bevis was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Aidanthompso. Benedikt Aidanthompso read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
alex._a_2010: On Day 7, Roland "Button" Alex arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Roland "Button" Alex sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Roland "Button" Alex took it personally.
Roland "Button" Alex brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Roland "Button" Alex stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A bullet grazed Roland "Button" Alex's ribs at S-S12. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben of the Hegemony (@jarvisben). The clerk counted the names twice. Roland "Button" Alex is number 473 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Roland "Button" Alex wrote to a girl from the dance hall, maybe that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Roland "Button" Alex walked back up the communication trench to S-S12, slower than before, but on his own feet.
A muddy dog crawled into S-S12 through the wire. Roland "Button" Alex gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Kaiser.
The corporal found out Roland "Button" Alex used to be a butcher's boy. Roland "Button" Alex has been doing two jobs ever since.
alexj.558: Anselm Alexj came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

The rain did not stop once. Anselm Alexj slept standing up, wedged against the wall of S-F2, and dreamt of dry socks. Hill 304 is lost. Anselm Alexj heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Anselm Alexj had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Valentin Bladestalker crossed it, Anselm Alexj fired. Valentin Bladestalker was grazed.
Asked what he will do after the war, Anselm Alexj said: 'Be a clockmaker in Varenne. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Anselm Alexj of the Concord lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at the Sunken Road. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Zeno Smiridisnick's name scratched on the lid.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Anselm Alexj helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F2 they left Anselm Alexj behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Bastian Enjoyer of the Hegemony (@autism_enjoyer_08).
A letter came with Leopold "Ghost" Alexj: "I am Anselm Alexj's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Leopold "Ghost" Alexj tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper. The clerk counted the names twice. Leopold "Ghost" Alexj is number 329 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Leopold "Ghost" Alexj watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Leopold "Ghost" Alexj had just lit a cigarette at S-F2 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Gideon Jesh of the Hegemony (@jesh20000).
Leopold "Ghost" Alexj tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back.
There was no room for Leopold "Ghost" Alexj. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Another member of the House of Alexj reached the line: Ivo Alexj. He asked where Leopold "Ghost" Alexj had slept, then chose a different corner.
axelat3: Ulrich Axelat arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his mother's thimble and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Ulrich Axelat was number 28. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Ulrich Axelat read a theatre review while peeling supper. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Ulrich Axelat let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Ulrich Axelat cut Valentin Zle's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Ulrich Axelat mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.

Ulrich Axelat stretched a scrap of canvas over the letters. Everything else could get wet first. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Ulrich Axelat read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Ulrich Axelat of the Concord spotted Zeno Ramsey of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Verdel Ridge. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
A flare lit Saint-Ash crossroads like noon. Ulrich Axelat counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Ulrich Axelat's ear at S-F12 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak). Ulrich Axelat was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Konrad "Ash" Sapino was grazed.
Ulrich Axelat's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Ulrich Axelat helped stack spare sandbags at S-F12. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Ulrich Axelat aimed just below it. Yann Duckman was grazed. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Ulrich Axelat kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Ulrich Axelat tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Ulrich Axelat lent Nils Lafayette a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Ulrich Axelat smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Teodor Klecka came out for a cup and was grazed.
collinhaney2: Cyril "Button" Collinhaney arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

The men at Q-F2 heard Cyril "Button" Collinhaney call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Viktor "Owl" Tawt of the Concord (@tawt_us). Cyril "Button" Collinhaney looked over the parapet at Q-F2 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Viktor "Owl" Tawt of the Concord (@tawt_us).

Teodor Collinhaney had heard about Cyril "Button" Collinhaney's courage. At Q-F2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Victory at Grey Mill. Teodor Collinhaney let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Teodor Collinhaney carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Teodor Collinhaney tried to remember the price of a loaf in Northwick. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Yann Nilsiiboy kept Teodor Collinhaney awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Yann could have walked there blind.
fordlowe: Day 10: Matthias Fordlowe reached P-F22 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Matthias Fordlowe's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. Grey Mill is lost. Matthias Fordlowe heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Matthias Fordlowe rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Pavel Wmacdon was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
Matthias Fordlowe borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
A second spoon disappeared. Matthias Fordlowe searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
heger_max: On the way to U-F22, Florian Max tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
A supply man offered Florian Max a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Florian Max remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
The wind carried away the last words of every order. Florian Max waited until the corporal came closer before picking up anything heavy.
heitoralmeida314: They issued Dorian Heitoralmeid a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a tin whistle in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Dorian Heitoralmeid had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Norbert Alexgreve was grazed. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Dorian Heitoralmeid did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Dorian Heitoralmeid counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Marek "Lucky" Chase was badly wounded. The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Dorian Heitoralmeid waited for that to change. When it did, Wendel Sharky was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dorian Heitoralmeid answered to number 806. Dorian Heitoralmeid walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Dorian Heitoralmeid had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Norbert Littlesaint was gravely wounded.
Dorian Heitoralmeid fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Teodor "Button" Magtyu, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
Dorian Heitoralmeid sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
jameson.308: At the depot, Arno "Doc" Jameson had practised answering to his name. At R-F21, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A sniper's bullet hit Arno "Doc" Jameson at R-F21. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Benedikt Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Arno "Doc" Jameson was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Arno "Doc" Jameson is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. A letter from home found Arno "Doc" Jameson before the night shift. Arno "Doc" Jameson folded it small and kept it close.

Arno "Doc" Jameson spent the day in bed with his leg propped up. The orderly changed the dressing and said it was healing the way it should. A letter from home found Arno "Doc" Jameson before the night shift. Arno "Doc" Jameson folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Arno "Doc" Jameson watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Back with his platoon, Arno "Doc" Jameson found that someone had kept his place on the fire step. Nobody admitted who.
Arno "Doc" Jameson checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.

Arno "Doc" Jameson and Dietrich Jackson tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home found Arno "Doc" Jameson before the night shift. Arno "Doc" Jameson folded it small and kept it close.
A bullet went through Arno "Doc" Jameson's sleeve at R-F21 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne).

A bullet struck Arno "Doc" Jameson below the ribs at R-F21. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Ulrich Olotro of the Hegemony (@_olotro_). Arno "Doc" Jameson was hit at R-F21 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Ulrich Olotro of the Hegemony (@_olotro_).

Walter Jameson took the same post at R-F21 where Arno "Doc" Jameson stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Walter Jameson transferred to the snipers. The men in R-F21 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Walter Jameson kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. A letter from home found Walter Jameson before the night shift. Walter Jameson folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Walter Jameson is number 313 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Walter Jameson wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Walter Jameson hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Walter Jameson lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-F21 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Pavel Emanvince was grazed.
Walter Jameson fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy was grazed.
just_ther758: The sergeant gave Clement Ther a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Clement Ther looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Clement Ther was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S1. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Lucien Tzukitolotl of the Hegemony (@tzukitolotl). Clement Ther got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 603. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-S1 with the rations. Clement Ther ate while listening to the revised orders.
The medics cleaned Clement Ther's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-S1.
Clement Ther was hit in the foot through his boot at S-S1. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg of the Hegemony (@drkevlagg).
Clement Ther spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
linktheduck: Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck came from Greyhallow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Nils Man drew a map of Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck's hometown from Hollow's stories. Hollow says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck found an old map of Calvary Farm from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
The wind carried away the last words of every order. Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck waited until the corporal came closer before picking up anything heavy.
mcwillzz: Day 12. The corporal put Nils Mcwillzz beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Nils Mcwillzz tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Nils Mcwillzz went out with the wiring party at N-F4. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
mika_de_roover: Edmund Roover arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in S-R15 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-R15 with the rations. Edmund Roover ate while listening to the revised orders. A letter from home found Edmund Roover before the night shift. Edmund Roover folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Roover and Valentin "Bones" Lonerius made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. Edmund Roover got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 947. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-R15, Edmund Roover listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Edmund Roover. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Edmund Roover borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Edmund Roover worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
nobody_8785: The old hands of Q-F22 have been here since Day 1. Rafael "Whistle" Nobody has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Severin Time pulled Rafael "Whistle" Nobody out of a flooded shell hole at the Ossuary Wood. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. Victory at Grey Mill. Rafael "Whistle" Nobody let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Rafael "Whistle" Nobody's hands still remember being a stonemason's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Rafael "Whistle" Nobody and Severin Time sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Rafael "Whistle" Nobody and Karel Adolfdavis tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
petr.kalina_: Matthias "Tin" Kalina came up the line with a pressed cornflower and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Matthias "Tin" Kalina waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Matthias "Tin" Kalina read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A pump handle snapped off in Matthias "Tin" Kalina's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
Matthias "Tin" Kalina lost a boot in the trench. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
Matthias "Tin" Kalina traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
s3ba_rp: Pavel Sbarp came from Coldwater, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Pavel Sbarp read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Pavel Sbarp fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too. The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel Sbarp is number 713 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-C12, Pavel Sbarp listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Pavel Sbarp made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Pavel Sbarp saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Florian Tetanusmaxxe, grazed.
Pavel Sbarp rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Tobias Kowalien was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
sean_sperring: Quentin "Mud" Sperring stepped off the supply cart at R-F19 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Quentin "Mud" Sperring taught Wendel Yaboyslydude to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Quentin "Mud" Sperring's name scratched on it. Karel Check kicked it back. It did not come again. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Quentin "Mud" Sperring looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Quentin "Mud" Sperring raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F19. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Quentin "Mud" Sperring is whole again, or near enough for the line.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Quentin "Mud" Sperring gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Quentin "Mud" Sperring in the open at R-F19. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne). Quentin "Mud" Sperring looked over the parapet at R-F19 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne).
Karel Sperring put a key to a house that is no longer there beside the bunk. Someone who had known Quentin "Mud" Sperring helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Karel Sperring was on the dawn watch at R-F19 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Karel Sperring was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus of the Hegemony (@oscizzus). The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-F19. Karel Sperring has learned to walk bent double.

Karel Sperring was hit through the stomach at R-F19. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Marek Adrian of the Hegemony (@diazjr.adrian). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Karel Sperring fell at R-F19 and never moved again. Shot by Marek Adrian of the Hegemony (@diazjr.adrian).

Isidor Sperring joined R-F19 under the shadow of Karel Sperring's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. The clerk counted the names twice. Isidor Sperring is number 249 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Isidor Sperring wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Isidor Sperring fixed the strap on Valentin "Mud" Chavo's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
A man asked Isidor Sperring to sit nearby without saying anything. He stayed until the man fell asleep.
Isidor Sperring held the mirror while Roland Rachelejosia shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
smabel_is_able: The quartermaster asked Felix Able to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Felix Able aimed just below it. Nils Tec was badly wounded. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Felix Able looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. Felix Able reported for duty as a chaplain. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Felix Able was hit through the stomach at P-F9. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Otto "Shadow" Ghost of the Hegemony (@tf141simon_riley_ghost). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Felix Able was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. The bleeding has stopped. Felix Able asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen. Mail came up the line with a letter for Felix Able. Felix Able read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Someone moved Felix Able's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Felix Able. He died on the stretcher before morning.
The papers connected Jonas Able to Felix Able. The men took longer to learn Jonas Able's own habits, but they made the effort.
the_cowboii: Tobias "Crow" Cowboii was a baker in Kesselby until the posters went up. He came to S-F14 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, and within a day the whole bay knew that he collects shell fuses.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii cut his hand to the bone on the wire at the Bone Quarry. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic.

Tobias "Crow" Cowboii's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Verdel Ridge has been won. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Tobias "Crow" Cowboii had Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony in the sights at the Chalk Pits for a long second. Severin Lagbagdotzip was lighting a pipe. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii let the match burn all the way down.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii and Yann Spring carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.

A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii and Edmund Fts compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Silas Menezes of the Hegemony (@julio.menezes921).
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii rejoined the squad at S-F14. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
